description: NaRh(SO₄)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are two shorter (2.43 Å) and four longer (2.51 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Rh is bonded to six O atoms to form RhO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (2.05 Å) and four longer (2.07 Å) Rh-O bond lengths. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent RhO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-51°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.45-1.52 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Rh, and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Rh and one S atom.
